name: djangonaut
description: Open the current Django project in DjangoNAUT — your Django Control Center (N+1 auto-fix, Migration Guard, DRF Explorer, Security).

djangonaut.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the DjangoNAUT executable. Supports `${env:VAR}` and `%VAR%`. Leave empty to auto-detect the installed app on Windows (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs`), macOS (`/Applications`) or the `djangonaut` CLI on PATH.
